transcript.speaker: Alice Johnson
transcript.text: Welcome to our Q3 planning session. Our main goal is to align on the roadmap for the next three months.

transcript.speaker: Alice Johnson
transcript.text: Before we dive in, let's look at the metrics from last quarter. We hit $2.5M in ARR.

transcript.speaker: Charlie Davis
transcript.text: That's fantastic. Engineering's primary focus for Q3 will be migrating to the new database cluster.

transcript.speaker: Diana Prince
transcript.text: Will that cause any downtime? We need to notify customers if it does.

transcript.speaker: Charlie Davis
transcript.text: We expect maybe 15 minutes of downtime on a Sunday night. I will do a risk assessment by next week.

transcript.speaker: Alice Johnson
transcript.text: Good. After the migration, what's next? We want to tackle the mobile app redesign.

transcript.speaker: Diana Prince
transcript.text: From the design side, we have wireframes ready for the mobile app.

transcript.speaker: Diana Prince
transcript.text: We need engineering to review them by next Friday so we can finalize the assets.

transcript.speaker: Charlie Davis
transcript.text: I'll assign two engineers to review the wireframes. We should have feedback for you on Monday.

transcript.speaker: Alice Johnson
transcript.text: Okay, Charlie, please schedule a design review meeting with your team. What about marketing?

transcript.speaker: Diana Prince
transcript.text: Marketing is planning a big push for the new mobile release. It will use up 40% of our Q3 budget.

transcript.speaker: Diana Prince
transcript.text: We need a confirmed launch date by mid-Q3 to start booking ads. When can we launch?

transcript.speaker: Charlie Davis
transcript.text: If everything goes perfectly, we can launch in early August. Maybe August 5th.

transcript.speaker: Alice Johnson
transcript.text: Let's be realistic. Are there any risks that might push it back?

transcript.speaker: Charlie Davis
transcript.text: If the database migration takes longer, it will push the mobile app out by a week.

transcript.speaker: Charlie Davis
transcript.text: I can commit to August 15th for the launch. Let's aim for that to be safe.

transcript.speaker: Diana Prince
transcript.text: August 15th works perfectly. I will draft the marketing copy tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Alice Johnson
transcript.text: Perfect. August 15th it is. Let's make sure all our action items reflect this timeline.

transcript.speaker: Alice Johnson
transcript.text: I also need someone to update the investor deck with the new Q3 metrics targets.

transcript.speaker: Diana Prince
transcript.text: I can take that action item. I'll have the deck updated by next week.

summary.overview_text: Q3 planning focused on the database migration and mobile app redesign. Engineering will spend a month on the database before starting the mobile app. A launch date of August 15th was agreed upon, allowing marketing to plan their push.

action_items.text: Do a risk assessment by next week
Update the investor deck with the new Q3 metrics targets
